node-gallery.title: Timeline Browsing and Search
node-gallery.description: TimelineRepository and TimelineQuery identify the timeline query boundary, while TimelineGrid, TimelineViewer, and TimelineDateNavigation provide gallery presentation responsibilities. SearchScreen supplies a separate search interface. GalleryPolishDeviceTest contains catalogued checks for preserving the first visible photo identity when density changes and keeping the date within the photo viewport. SqliteViewerSession references an entries entity; its durability beyond the viewer session is not established.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing gallery density preserves the actual first visible photo identity.
The date indicator remains within the photo viewport.

node-library-storage.title: Photo Records and Media Storage
node-library-storage.description: PhotoDatabase declares photos, import_items, and handoffs, while LibraryDatabase declares albums, album_photos, edit_drafts, people, faces, and face_scans. LibraryFollowupDatabase adds device_media and device_scan_seen. PhotoRepository, MediaCache, StorageBudget, and DeviceCopyIdentity provide repository, media-access, capacity, and identity abstractions around this state. LibraryMigration and versioned app/schemas files establish schema evolution evidence. A device test directly resolves a device_media.photoId through the photos access surface.
acceptanceCriteria: A device_media.photoId produced by reconciliation resolves through database.photos().find.

node-people.title: People Identity and Face Regions
node-people.description: PeopleRepository and PeopleWorker identify people-processing responsibilities. FaceRegion and FaceRegions describe face-region abstractions, while CanonicalPersonGroup and CanonicalPeopleState identify canonical identity grouping. CanonicalPeopleIndexTest supplies reviewed and new catalog items, including the rule that a missing face must not create a person. LibraryDatabase separately owns the evidenced people, faces, and face_scans entity declarations.
acceptanceCriteria: A missing face does not create a person in the canonical people index.
